summary: MediaAlpha filed an 8-K reporting the purchase of Insignia's interest in a Tax Receivables Agreement (TRA) for $31.0 million cash, a 55% discount to the $68.7 million estimated liability. The Board, including disinterested directors, approved the transaction. The buyback reduces future TRA liabilities from $123.4 million to an estimated $55.0 million; funded from cash on hand and revolving credit. This liability management move is not a special situation category event.
